falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 80% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug assumed a higher low structure; a break below 4,800 would violate the August 2024 bottom's key support level and invalidate the bottoming pattern thesis

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 25 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The BLOWOFF SCORE of 40 suggests controlled volatility/early-stage rally; sustained VIX above 25 indicates panic selling or crash conditions, not a bottom formation, invalidating the HOLD signal

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield spread inverts further below -50 basis points
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A deepening inversion would signal worsening recession expectations and credit stress, contradicting the bottom_2024_aug pattern which occurred during stable-to-improving yield curve dynamics

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
